dataset.label_provenance: LLM output under the contract in src/twcs/prompts.py, one uniform random sample of 5000 reconstructed threads (seed 20260729); not human ground truth. Every score below measures agreement with those labels.
dataset.sample_manifest: data/twcs/sample_pool_5000.txt is referenced by the original repo but is not present in the checkout; the labeled file itself is the authoritative sample.

split.protocol: sklearn.model_selection.train_test_split(X, y, test_size=0.20, random_state=42, stratify=y) in file order, then train_test_split(X_train_full, y_train_full, test_size=0.10, random_state=42, stratify=y_train_full). Row level; one thread per row.
split.leakage_check: Reproduced on 2026-09-13: 2 duplicate first_customer_text values (5 rows) all fall in train; no text appears in more than one split; one row per thread so no conversation leakage. The original split is therefore usable as-is; no corrected grouped split is required.

preprocessing.text: raw first_customer_text with NaN -> empty string; no lowercasing, whitespace collapsing, URL stripping or truncation outside the tokenizer
preprocessing.tokenizer: distilbert-base-uncased WordPiece (lowercases internally), truncation=True, max_length=128, dynamic padding per batch

model.head: AutoModelForSequenceClassification(num_labels=2), fresh classification head
model.loss: CrossEntropyLoss with sklearn-style balanced class weights computed on the training labels

hyperparameters.scheduler: OneCycleLR(max_lr=lr, pct_start=warmup_ratio, anneal_strategy='linear') over all steps

selection.learning_rate: swept over [2e-05, 3e-05, 5e-05] with seed 42 on validation macro F1 at threshold 0.5; 3e-05 selected (val 0.8282, epochs best 3)
selection.epoch: model state from the epoch with the best validation macro F1 at threshold 0.5 is restored (seed 42: epoch 3)
selection.threshold: fixed 0.5 for every reported figure; the notebook's threshold sweep on the test set is analysis only and was not used for selection

metric.definition: sklearn f1_score(y_test, prob >= 0.5, average='macro') on the 1000-row test split
metric.triagekit_equivalent: ClassificationMetrics.macro_f1 with contract classification_threshold.objective=fixed, fixed_threshold=0.5; metrics_version 1

reported.verified: 2026-09-13: reconstructed split and re-scored the saved seed-42 weights (models/twcs/distilbert) with the original environment: macro F1 0.7842, confusion tn 630 fp 64 fn 111 tp 195, exact match.

tfidf_reference.protocol: same first 80/20 stratified split only (4000 train / 1000 test, no validation slice); TfidfVectorizer(max_features=10000, ngram_range=(1,2), stop_words='english', sublinear_tf=True) + LogisticRegression(class_weight='balanced', C=1.0, max_iter=1000, lbfgs, random_state=42); threshold 0.5
tfidf_reference.verified: 2026-09-13: re-scored saved models/twcs/tfidf/tfidf_twcs.pkl on the reconstructed test split: 0.7327, exact match.

environment.device: Apple Silicon MPS (README states M3 Pro)
environment.determinism: MPS fine-tuning is not bit-deterministic; the original README reports about 0.005 macro F1 variation between re-runs

tolerance.justification: Observed seed-to-seed std is 0.0128 (range 0.7842 to 0.8097, 0.0255 wide) and the original author reports about 0.005 non-determinism per re-run on MPS. A single-seed replication is judged against that seed's own reported figure with an absolute tolerance of 0.02 (roughly 1.5 std plus re-run noise). A three-seed mean is judged against 0.7969 with 0.015 (the standard error of a three-seed mean is 0.0074; 0.015 is about two of those). Replication under a different torch/transformers version, Python version or device is reported with those differences listed and is not upgraded to an exact-environment claim.
